name: Porch, Connecticut
lede: The owner of a traditional Connecticut house wanted the outdoor spaces in use once the warm weather was over. White Tungsten Electric heaters, recessed into the porch ceiling, make it so.
data: Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric 6000 W, white, recessed

hero.caption: Recessed heaters in the white porch ceiling. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

photos.caption: Three white Tungsten Electric heaters in a beadboard ceiling. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.
The dimmer controller enclosure. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: An elegant, traditional residence in Connecticut, with outdoor spaces that its owner wanted to keep using in the New England climate.
Once the warm weather was over, the outdoor spaces went unused. Extending their season was the priority.
White Tungsten Smart-Heat Electric 6000 W heaters were recessed into the outdoor ceilings with a flush mounting kit, run on Wireless Dimmer Controllers.
